newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end steady to lower.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end steady to lower.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures closed steady to lower on Tuesday, reflecting price falls on the Chicago corn market over the long weekend, traders said.
Prices were unchanged to 120 yen lower, with the benchmark November 1997 steady at 13,950 yen per tonne. Daily volume was 53,073 lots.
Most contracts were weaker at the opening on light selling by individual investors, traders said.
But investors could not find clear direction later, and the market showed narrow price fluctuations throughout the day, they said.
The spot December contract on the CBOT Project A corn trading system was being traded at $2.60-1/2 per bushel at 0855 GMT, against $2.61-3/4 at Monday's close.
The spot November of the CBOT soybean futures on the Project A overnight trading system was at $6.68-1/2 at 0855 GMT, against $6.66 at Monday's close.
